scripts._comment_test_rules: Pinned to firebase-tools 13: version 14+ requires JDK 21, and this machine has JDK 11. Install a JDK 21+ and you can drop the @13 to track latest.
scripts._comment_test_permissions: Catalogue hygiene (ids are storage keys), a drift check that every permission the code enforces is one an admin can actually grant, and a check that firestore.rules has not lost a collection from its blanket-write exclusion chain. No emulator needed.
scripts._comment_test_conflicts: Double-booking detection: a renamed dentist's existing appointments must still block their own slots, and cancellations must release theirs.
scripts._comment_test_ledger: The one place a ledger row is built: every payment carries its dentist, and the lab fee is charged exactly once per procedure.
scripts._comment_test_delete: The one delete rule, shared by every screen: a charge with payments recorded against it cannot be deleted until they are.
scripts._comment_test_recyclebin: The recycle bin's boundaries. A server route bypasses firestore.rules entirely, so every limit the rules enforce is re-enforced here or it is gone: path escapes, audit trails, the Admin short-circuit, and a restore that never overwrites.
scripts._comment_test_clinicstatus: Does the server agree with firestore.rules about whether a clinic may still be written to? The rules gate browser writes; the Admin SDK routes bypass rules entirely, so the same decision has to exist in code or an expired clinic keeps taking payments through a route that never asked.
scripts._comment_test_storage: Where uploaded files land. Four of six upload sites had no clinic in the path, two of them flat folders every clinic shares — and a Storage rule cannot scope what the path does not name. Also asserts storage.rules exists and is deployed, since it did not exist at all until 2026-08-24.
scripts._comment_test_restore: What a per-clinic restore may touch. The refusals matter more than the copying: users holds clinicRoles for EVERY clinic a person works at, and sms_outbox is drained by a worker that sends without a human and never expires a message. Includes a drift check against the root collections firestore.rules declares, which caught five the hand-written list had missed.
scripts._comment_test_teeth: What the odontogram may claim was done to a tooth. This is a medical record drawn as a picture, so the failure mode is a dentist believing it and being wrong: planned work must never repaint a tooth, an extraction outranks everything done before it, and a treatment colour must never be mistakable for a diagnosis colour.
scripts._comment_test_repair: The historical payment repair's classifier. The assertions that matter most are the ones that refuse to touch a row whose commission was corrected by hand.
scripts._comment_test_discount: Price lists and discounts. The two rules that matter: the lab fee is never discounted, and commission is calculated on the net.
scripts._comment_test_branches: Price lists scoped to branches: one default per scope, and no branch quoting another branch's rates.
scripts._comment_test_briefing: The arithmetic behind the daily and weekly brief: double-counted revenue, lateness read on the clinic clock, absence claimed before a shift starts. No network, no emulator.
scripts._comment_test_modeltext: Markdown/bidi/injection cases for the model-text renderer used by the printed treatment plan. No network, no emulator.
